appearance.title: Anna
appearance.visualDescription: Young woman with short black hair and brown eyes. She wears a bright red sweater and white sneakers.

pages.bio: Hi! I am Anna. I am 22 years old. I am tall. I have short black hair and brown eyes. I like bright red clothes!
I wear a red sweater, blue jeans, and white shoes. I have a big happy smile every day!

appearance.opener: Hello! I am Anna. Do you like red sweaters or blue jeans?
appearance.prompt: Describe Anna. What color is her hair? What clothes does she wear?

appearance.title: Marco
appearance.visualDescription: Tall young man with curly brown hair, green eyes, and black glasses. He wears a green t-shirt and blue denim jacket.

pages.bio: Hello! My name is Marco. I am 25 years old. I am tall. I have curly brown hair and green eyes.
I wear black glasses and a short beard. My clothes are simple: a green t-shirt and a blue jacket.

appearance.opener: Hi! Do you wear glasses or have curly hair?
appearance.prompt: What color are Marco's eyes and hair? Does he wear glasses?

professions.title: Baker (Chef John)
professions.visualDescription: Man in a white hat and apron. He makes fresh bread and cakes in a bakery.

pages.bio: I am a baker. I wake up at 4:00 AM every morning. I make fresh bread, warm croissants, and cakes.
I work in a big kitchen. It smells like warm bread and sugar. I sell food to happy customers.

professions.opener: Good morning! Do you like fresh bread or sweet cake?
professions.prompt: What does Chef John make every morning? Is his job early or late?

professions.title: Doctor (Dr. Sarah)
professions.visualDescription: Doctor wearing a white coat and blue stethoscope in a bright clinic.

pages.bio: I am a doctor. I work in a hospital. I help sick people feel better and stay healthy.
I wear a white coat. I talk to children and adults every day. I give good medicine.

professions.opener: Hello! How are you today? Do you feel good?
professions.prompt: Where does Dr. Sarah work? What clothes does she wear?

properties.title: Cozy Studio Flat
properties.visualDescription: Small studio flat with a big sunny window, yellow sofa, and small kitchen.

pages.bio: I am a small studio flat. I have one room, a yellow sofa, a small kitchen, and a clean bathroom.
I am near the bus stop and the supermarket. I am cheap and cozy for one student.

properties.opener: Welcome! Do you like small cozy flats or big houses?
properties.prompt: Name 3 things inside this studio flat using simple words.

properties.title: Red Brick House
properties.visualDescription: Two-story red brick house with a green lawn and white fence.

pages.bio: I am a red brick house. I have two bedrooms, one living room, a garage, and a green garden.
I am on a quiet green street. My garden is good for dogs and children.

properties.opener: Hello! Do you like a green garden or a city flat?
icebreakers: I prefer living in the city!
properties.prompt: Is this house in a city or a quiet village? How many bedrooms does it have?

character.title: Kind & Friendly Friend
character.visualDescription: Smiling young person holding a warm cup of cocoa.

pages.bio: I am kind and polite. I say 'please' and 'thank you'. I like helping my friends and neighbors.
I smile at people on the street. I remember birthdays and bring sweet cookies to my friends.

character.opener: Hello my friend! How are you today?
character.prompt: What does a kind person do? Describe 2 simple actions.

hobbies.title: Cycling in the Park
hobbies.visualDescription: Red bicycle parked near a green tree in a park.

pages.bio: I ride a red bicycle in the park every weekend. It is easy, cheap, and fun!
I feel the cool wind. I listen to music and eat delicious ice cream at the park cafe.

hobbies.opener: Hello! Can you ride a bicycle? Do you ride in the park?
icebreakers: No, but I want to learn!
hobbies.prompt: Where do you like to ride a bicycle or walk? What do you see in the park?

nationalities.title: Kenji (Japanese 🇯🇵)
nationalities.visualDescription: Young Japanese man with neat short dark hair, wearing a traditional summer yukata robe.

pages.bio: Konnichiwa! I am Kenji. I am Japanese. I live in Tokyo, Japan. My language is Japanese.
In Japan, we eat fresh sushi and hot ramen. I drink green tea every day!

nationalities.opener: Konnichiwa! What is your nationality? Where are you from?
nationalities.prompt: What is Kenji's nationality and home country? What food does he eat?

nationalities.title: Sofia (Italian 🇮🇹)
nationalities.visualDescription: Italian woman with brown wavy hair in Rome.

pages.bio: Ciao! I am Sofia. I am Italian. I come from Rome in Italy. I speak Italian.
Italy is famous for pizza, pasta, and sweet gelato. I cook fresh pasta at home!

nationalities.opener: Ciao! Do you like Italian pizza or sweet gelato?
nationalities.prompt: Where is Sofia from? What is her nationality and native food?

appearance.title: Elena (Athletic & Wavy Auburn Hair)
appearance.visualDescription: Athletic woman with medium shoulder-length wavy auburn hair, hazel eyes, light freckles, wearing a navy blue striped shirt.

pages.bio: I am Elena, 24 years old. I am medium height and athletic because I exercise every day. I have wavy auburn hair and hazel eyes with cute freckles.
I love casual nautical clothes like navy striped shirts and leather sandals because they are comfortable for beach walks in summer.

appearance.opener: Hi! What is your favorite season for casual fashion?
appearance.prompt: Describe Elena's build, hair color, and clothing style using A2 connector words.

appearance.title: Liam (Tall & Tailored Suit Style)
appearance.visualDescription: Tall 6'2" man with neat dark blonde side-part hair and sharp jawline, wearing a tailored navy blazer and clean white shirt.

pages.bio: I am Liam, 27 years old. I am tall (6'2") with a slim frame and broad shoulders. I have short dark blonde hair and a clean-shaven face.
I prefer smart-casual elegance because I work in an office. I usually wear navy blazers, white shirts, a leather watch, and brown shoes.

appearance.opener: Hello! Do you prefer dressing up formally or wearing cozy casual hoodies?
appearance.prompt: How tall is Liam? What does he wear for work and why?

professions.title: Graphic Designer (Nina)
professions.visualDescription: Creative designer sitting with a drawing tablet, stylus pen, and colorful art posters.

pages.bio: I am Nina, a graphic designer! I create colorful logos, website banners, and advertisements for local companies because I love art.
I work on my laptop and drawing tablet. I choose beautiful fonts, combine matching colors, and draw digital illustrations.

greenFlags: ✓ Flexible work from home or cafes
✓ See your posters in city streets

professions.opener: Hey! What color combination do you like for a website?
professions.prompt: What tools does Nina use for her work? Why does she enjoy her job?

professions.title: Fitness Trainer (Alex)
professions.visualDescription: Fit trainer wearing a black gym shirt and stopwatch, guiding a client in the gym.

pages.bio: I am Alex, a fitness trainer. I design exercise programs and teach people how to stay strong and healthy every day.
I help clients with gym weights, running workouts, and meal plans so they can achieve their physical goals.

professions.opener: Hey! Do you prefer morning gym sessions or evening relaxing walks?
professions.prompt: What does Alex do to help his clients? Would you like a personal trainer?

properties.title: Modern Loft Apartment
properties.visualDescription: Industrial loft with high concrete ceilings, large glass windows, leather couch, and kitchen island.

pages.bio: This is a spacious one-bedroom industrial loft. It has high ceilings, large glass windows, and a modern open kitchen island.
It is located in the Arts District near art galleries and coffee shops, so you can walk everywhere easily.

properties.opener: Hi! Do you like big industrial lofts with city views?
properties.prompt: Describe the main features of this loft apartment and its location.

properties.title: Suburban Cottage with Garden
properties.visualDescription: Cozy stone cottage with flower boxes, wooden porch swing, lawn, and chimney.

pages.bio: This is a charming three-bedroom suburban cottage. It features a cozy stone fireplace, a sunny porch, and a flower garden.
It is in a peaceful neighborhood near primary schools and bicycle paths, which makes it perfect for families.

properties.opener: Hello! Would you like to sit on the porch swing and enjoy the garden?
properties.prompt: Compare this suburban cottage with the city loft apartment using A2 vocabulary.

character.title: Organized & Reliable (Sophia)
character.visualDescription: Focused young woman checking off tasks in a paper planner at her clean desk.

pages.bio: I am Sophia. I am very organized, punctual, and reliable. I never arrive late because I respect time.
I use a daily planner to write my tasks, prepare my clothes the night before, and keep my desk clean.

character.opener: Hi! Do you like to plan your week ahead or do you make spontaneous decisions?
character.prompt: Why is reliability an important trait in friendship? Give an example.

hobbies.title: Sourdough Bread Baking
hobbies.visualDescription: Golden loaf of sourdough bread on a wooden cutting board with a knife.

pages.bio: I love baking artisanal sourdough bread at home. I mix simple flour, water, and starter, then bake it in a hot oven.
My kitchen smells wonderful when the bread bakes. The warm crust crackles when it cools down, and it tastes delicious with butter!

hobbies.opener: Fresh sourdough bread from the oven! Do you prefer butter or olive oil?
hobbies.prompt: Explain the basic steps of sourdough baking using simple present tenses.

nationalities.title: Mateo (Mexican 🇲🇽)
nationalities.visualDescription: Mexican man in an embroidered shirt holding corn tacos in a town square.

pages.bio: Hola! I am Mateo from Oaxaca, Mexico. I am proud of my Mexican nationality and rich cultural heritage.
We celebrate Day of the Dead with yellow marigold flowers, and we eat spicy mole sauce with fresh corn tacos.

redFlags: ✗ Says salsa is not spicy when it burns

nationalities.opener: Hola! Do you like spicy Mexican food or traditional cultural festivals?
icebreakers: Day of the Dead looks beautiful!
nationalities.prompt: Describe Mateo's nationality, traditions, and traditional dishes using A2 connectors.

nationalities.title: Freja (Danish 🇩🇰)
nationalities.visualDescription: Danish woman riding a bicycle along Copenhagen harbor in a sweater.

pages.bio: Hej! My name is Freja. I am Danish and I live in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish culture values comfort and 'hygge'.
We ride bicycles everywhere in rain or sunny weather. We enjoy open rye bread sandwiches and candlelit evenings.

nationalities.opener: Hej! Do you prefer cycling around city streets or taking café breaks?
nationalities.prompt: What country is Freja from? Describe two aspects of Danish lifestyle.

appearance.title: Maya (Boho-Chic & Shoulder-Length Curls)
appearance.visualDescription: Artistic woman with voluminous dark brown curly hair and expressive dark eyes, wearing an embroidered bohemian kimono and silver rings.

pages.bio: I'm Maya, a 26-year-old artist who is recognized by her expressive dark eyes, sun-kissed complexion, and voluminous shoulder-length dark brown curls.
I express my artistic identity through bohemian fashion, which includes flowing embroidered cardigans, vintage silver jewelry, and suede boots.

greenFlags: ✓ Expressive facial features that reflect emotion
✓ Unique personal style that stands out

appearance.opener: Hey! How would you describe the relationship between your fashion choices and your personal identity?
appearance.prompt: Describe Maya's appearance using relative clauses (who, which) and descriptive vocabulary.

appearance.title: Julian (Broad-Shouldered & Rugged Style)
appearance.visualDescription: Broad-shouldered man with a trimmed dark beard and short undercut hair, wearing a heavy flannel plaid shirt and durable leather boots.

pages.bio: I'm Julian, a 29-year-old outdoor enthusiast who stands 6'1" tall with a broad-shouldered frame, a neatly trimmed beard, and hazel eyes.
My wardrobe centers around functional outdoor aesthetic, featuring heavy flannel plaid shirts, dark selvedge denim, and sturdy leather hiking boots.

appearance.opener: Greetings! Do you favor a clean-cut corporate style or an outdoor rugged aesthetic?
appearance.prompt: Analyze Julian's physical appearance and explain how his wardrobe reflects his lifestyle.

professions.title: Software Engineer (Marcus)
professions.visualDescription: Software engineer working at a dual-monitor standing desk, wearing noise-canceling headphones.

pages.bio: I'm Marcus, a Full-Stack Software Engineer who develops web applications and cloud algorithms that transform complex data into user-friendly software.
My main responsibilities include writing clean code, reviewing pull requests, solving logical bugs, and collaborating with designers remotely.

professions.opener: Hello world! Are you fascinated or intimidated by software development and modern technology?
professions.prompt: Explain the responsibilities of a software engineer using intermediate career vocabulary.

professions.title: Environmental Journalist (Clara)
professions.visualDescription: Journalist holding a recording microphone, interviewing an engineer near wind turbines.

pages.bio: I'm Clara, an investigative environmental journalist who investigates climate change solutions and reports on clean energy initiatives across the globe.
My work involves interviewing climate scientists, conducting field research, verifying facts, and publishing news features that inform the public.

professions.opener: Hi! What environmental topic or social cause do you feel most passionate about discussing?
professions.prompt: What key skills and ethical duties are necessary for an environmental journalist?

properties.title: Converted Paper Mill Loft
properties.visualDescription: Historic paper mill converted into a luxury loft with exposed red brick, heavy timber beams, and river views.

pages.bio: This 2-bedroom loft is located inside a converted 19th-century paper mill that successfully combines original exposed brickwork and timber beams with contemporary interior design.
Residents enjoy a private balcony overlooking the riverfront promenade, integrated smart lighting, an underground garage, and exclusive fitness center access.

properties.opener: Welcome! Do you prefer historic renovated properties or brand-new minimalist architecture?
properties.prompt: Evaluate the architectural contrast between historic industrial brickwork and modern fixtures.

properties.title: Eco-Friendly Solar Villa
properties.visualDescription: Sustainable two-story villa with rooftop solar panels, rainwater harvesting, vertical plant wall, and timber deck.

pages.bio: This innovative 3-bedroom zero-emission villa is powered by rooftop solar panels and relies on triple-pane insulation and rainwater collection to minimize environmental impact.
Key features include an organic vegetable garden patch, an electric vehicle charging dock, an indoor vertical plant wall, and negligible energy bills.

properties.opener: Greetings! How important is sustainable eco-friendly engineering when selecting a residence?
properties.prompt: Describe the sustainable technologies integrated into this eco-friendly villa.

character.title: Empathetic & Intuitive (Daniel)
character.visualDescription: Warm-hearted man listening intently during a conversation at a quiet coffee shop.

pages.bio: I'm Daniel, a 28-year-old counselor who values high emotional intelligence, active listening, and sincere empathy in personal relationships.
Friends frequently seek my advice when they encounter difficult challenges because I offer non-judgmental support and honest feedback.

character.opener: Hello! Do you consider yourself more guided by logical analysis or emotional intuition when making choices?
character.prompt: Explain how emotional intelligence helps resolve interpersonal conflicts between friends.

hobbies.title: Bouldering & Rock Climbing
hobbies.visualDescription: Climber wearing chalk bag, gripping indoor bouldering holds on an overhang wall.

pages.bio: Bouldering is an engaging physical hobby where climbers solve vertical routes on climbing walls using chalked hands and core strength.
This sport combines tactical problem solving similar to chess with full-body functional endurance, offering a rewarding sense of achievement.

redFlags: ✗ Chalk dust on clothes and gear

hobbies.opener: Hey! Have you ever attempted indoor bouldering or rock climbing?
hobbies.prompt: Describe how rock climbing combines physical conditioning with mental focus.

nationalities.title: Amara (Nigerian 🇳🇬)
nationalities.visualDescription: Nigerian woman wearing a patterned Ankara headwrap and traditional attire in Lagos.

pages.bio: Kedu! I'm Amara, a proud Nigerian from Lagos. Nigeria is a multicultural nation with over 250 distinct ethnic groups, rich oral traditions, and energetic Afrobeats music.
Our celebratory gatherings feature spicy smoky Jollof rice, fried plantains, and vibrant traditional clothing with elaborate Gele headwraps.

greenFlags: ✓ Hosts festive dinner parties with Afrobeats playlists
redFlags: ✗ Debates Jollof rice culinary origins for hours
✗ Expects strict formal deference to elders

nationalities.opener: Kedu! How familiar are you with West African culinary traditions and global Afrobeats music?
icebreakers: I've heard about the Jollof debate!
nationalities.prompt: Discuss Amara's Nigerian cultural identity, gastronomy, and musical heritage using intermediate language.

nationalities.title: Aarav (Indian 🇮🇳)
nationalities.visualDescription: Indian man in a blue kurta near Jaipur monuments holding cardamom chai.

pages.bio: Namaste! I'm Aarav from Jaipur, India. Indian nationality encompasses a pluralistic heritage, architectural wonders, and centuries of diverse regional customs.
Our cultural ethos prioritizes 'Atithi Devo Bhava' (The Guest is God). I enjoy brewing authentic cardamom masala chai and preparing fragrant spiced biryani.

redFlags: ✗ Insists tea bag chai is unacceptable

nationalities.opener: Namaste! Have you experienced Indian spice gastronomy or historical architectural monuments?
icebreakers: I drink masala chai every day!
nationalities.prompt: Examine Aarav's Indian nationality, cultural ethos of hospitality, and gastronomy.

appearance.title: Victoria (Statuesque Elegance & Platinum Bob)
appearance.visualDescription: Statuesque 5'10" woman with a razor-sharp platinum blonde bob, piercing ice-blue eyes, high cheekbones, wearing an asymmetrical black blazer.

pages.bio: I'm Victoria, 29. My statuesque 5'10" silhouette is defined by prominent high cheekbones, piercing ice-blue eyes, and a precision-cut platinum blonde bob.
My sartorial philosophy embodies high-fashion minimalist tailoring, incorporating structured monochromatic blazers, sleek leather boots, and subtle gold accents.

appearance.opener: Welcome! How significantly does sartorial elegance and visual poise influence your interpersonal perception?
appearance.prompt: Examine the stylistic impact of Victoria's minimalist wardrobe, hair structure, and commanding demeanor.

appearance.title: Gabriel (Charismatic & Silver-Templed Style)
appearance.visualDescription: Charismatic 34-year-old man with distinguished silver-templed dark hair and captivating dimples, wearing a tailored charcoal wool coat and silk scarf.

pages.bio: I'm Gabriel, 34. Standing at an athletic 6'0", my appearance balances distinguished silver-templed dark hair, warm hazel eyes, and expressive dimples when laughing.
I favor classic European sophistication: tailored charcoal wool overcoats, cashmere turtlenecks, antique leather loafers, and a vintage timepiece.

greenFlags: ✓ Warm disarming smile with natural dimples

appearance.opener: Greetings! Do you believe personal style should evolve dynamically or anchor to timeless classicism?
appearance.prompt: Analyze how Gabriel's physical attributes convey maturity, charisma, and European sophistication.

professions.title: AI Ethics Researcher (Dr. Aris)
professions.visualDescription: Researcher auditing algorithmic bias charts on transparent displays in a university research laboratory.

pages.bio: I'm Dr. Aris, an Artificial Intelligence Ethics Researcher evaluating autonomous algorithms to mitigate systemic bias, ensure data privacy, and enforce accountability.
My duties encompass drafting policy governance frameworks, advising corporate executives, and auditing machine learning models to prevent discriminatory automated decisions.

greenFlags: ✓ Pioneering crucial safeguards at the frontier of technology
✓ Intellectual rigor and high-level policy advocacy

professions.opener: Greetings! In your assessment, should artificial intelligence development be governed by binding international regulatory frameworks?
professions.prompt: Evaluate the moral dilemmas, policy challenges, and societal impact of AI ethics research.

professions.title: Architectural Conservationist (Soren)
professions.visualDescription: Architect examining intricate stonework details of a historic cathedral during a restoration project.

pages.bio: I'm Soren, an Architectural Conservationist specializing in adaptive reuse—restoring landmark heritage edifices while modernizing their structural utility sustainably.
My work entails conducting 3D laser diagnostics on masonry, procuring period-accurate sustainable materials, and preventing historical landmarks from urban demolition.

greenFlags: ✓ Tangible cultural legacy and artistic preservation

professions.opener: Hello! How can municipal planners effectively balance historic preservation with expanding urban infrastructure demands?
professions.prompt: Analyze the ideological debate between historical architectural conservation and contemporary urban development.

properties.title: Penthouse Sky Villa
properties.visualDescription: Luxury penthouse terrace featuring a private glass-edge infinity pool, 360-degree skyline panoramas, and smart automation.

pages.bio: This exquisite 4,500 sq ft top-floor Sky Villa features a private cantilevered glass-edge infinity pool, 360-degree panoramic skyline vistas, and biometric smart automation.
The residence offers keyless direct elevator access, a climate-controlled sommelier wine cellar, motorized curtain glass facades, and rooftop helipad privileges.

redFlags: ✗ Slight high-altitude structural sway in severe storms

properties.opener: Welcome to the sky! To what degree does high-end architectural luxury justify its ecological and socio-urban footprint?
properties.prompt: Analyze the architectural engineering, structural dynamics, and urban exclusivity of high-rise penthouse living.

properties.title: Alpine Timber Chalet
properties.visualDescription: Rustic timber chalet set in alpine pine forests, featuring cathedral glass windows, cedar sauna, and stone hearth.

pages.bio: Nestled into alpine slopes, this magnificent 4-bedroom timber chalet showcases double-height cathedral windows framing snow-draped pine valleys and a massive granite fireplace.
The estate provides ski-in/ski-out convenience, an outdoor cedar wood sauna, geothermal radiant floor heating, and handcrafted oak joinery by local artisans.

greenFlags: ✓ Immediate proximity to alpine ski resorts
redFlags: ✗ Intermittent road blockages during severe blizzards

properties.opener: Greetings! Would you thrive immersed in mountain isolation, or do you require urban velocity to stay stimulated?
properties.prompt: Evaluate how residing in isolated natural topography influences psychological well-being and daily routine.

character.title: Visionary & Resilient (Helena)
character.visualDescription: Determined female executive standing on a terrace overlooking the city skyline.

pages.bio: I'm Helena, 32. My character is anchored by strategic foresight, unflinching resilience during crises, and an unwavering commitment to empowering my team.
I view setbacks not as failures, but as invaluable empirical data for growth, driving innovation through calculated risk-taking and radical transparency.

character.opener: Greetings! What fundamental leadership qualities distinguish transformational visionaries from conventional managers?
character.prompt: Differentiate between transactional management and transformative resilient leadership in modern organizations.

hobbies.title: 35mm Analog Film Photography
hobbies.visualDescription: Vintage 35mm film camera resting on a darkroom wooden bench next to developed negatives.

pages.bio: 35mm film photography requires deliberate artistic composition and patience, restricting the photographer to 36 exposures per roll without instantaneous digital previews.
Developing chemical negatives in darkrooms allows photographers to embrace grain textures, light leaks, and unedited candid human authenticity.

greenFlags: ✓ Tangible physical medium and archival prints
redFlags: ✗ Escalating chemical and film canister expenses

hobbies.opener: Greetings! How does the deliberate artistic constraint of analog film alter creative expression compared to digital photographic abundance?
hobbies.prompt: Critique the psychological and aesthetic divergences between digital smartphone photography and traditional 35mm analog film.

nationalities.title: Camille (French 🇫🇷)
nationalities.visualDescription: French woman in a trench coat seated at a Parisian pavement café with wine.

pages.bio: Bonjour. I am Camille from Paris. French identity is fundamentally defined by 'art de vivre'—the intellectual art of living refinedly through literature, philosophy, and culinary mastery.
Our gastronomic meal is UNESCO-recognized intangible cultural heritage, celebrating wine terroir pairings, artisanal raw milk cheeses, and animated philosophical debate.

greenFlags: ✓ Refined palate for wine and artisanal cheese terroir
redFlags: ✗ Uncompromising stance on baguette crust density
✗ Dramatic sighs when served tap water

nationalities.opener: Bonjour! To what extent does national heritage shape your daily philosophical outlook and culinary discernment?
icebreakers: I admire the Parisian art de vivre!
nationalities.prompt: Analyze Camille's expression of French cultural heritage, 'art de vivre', and gastronomic philosophy.

nationalities.title: Leandro (Brazilian 🇧🇷)
nationalities.visualDescription: Brazilian man playing beach volleyball on Ipanema Beach in Rio de Janeiro.

pages.bio: Olá! I'm Leandro from Rio de Janeiro. Brazilian nationality represents a vibrant demographic melting pot harmonizing Indigenous, African, and European cultural lineage.
From syncopated Carnival rhythms to Bossa Nova nostalgia and communal feijoada banquets, our culture thrives on uninhibited warmth, optimism, and social cohesion.

greenFlags: ✓ Infectious warmth and disarming social energy
✓ Acoustic guitar proficiency playing bossa nova
redFlags: ✗ Punctuality viewed as a flexible social suggestion
✗ Effusive physical cheek-kisses for new acquaintances

nationalities.opener: Olá! How do you conceptualize the interplay between cultural syncretism, musical heritage, and national identity?
nationalities.prompt: Evaluate Leandro's articulation of Brazilian multicultural syncretism, musical heritage, and communal social ethos.
